## What it is

A 220 mm stackable tower column. Print four.

## Design notes

Two segments make each 440 mm column while every print remains below the Kobra S1's 250 mm height. Each end has two separate 18 mm-deep sockets for the printed 5.0 mm alignment pins. The bottom sockets close with 45-degree conical roofs so they print support-free without becoming through-holes.

## Don't

Do not restore the original through-bores: the pins slipped straight through and could not locate the joint. Do not restore the narrow integral tongue: it caused the full-width mast to begin on air in the print orientation. Do not use a single column; the forward phone load would twist it.

## Changelog

- 2026-08-07: Replaced the unsupported tongue joint with twin alignment pins.
- 2026-08-07: Replaced continuous pin bores with stopped, support-free end sockets after the first printed mast exposed the slip-through fault.
